LESSON: MODELING USING BALL TECHNIQUE

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: MODELLING
Topic 4.1: Modeling using ball technique

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Modeling using ball technique. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify materials for modeling 2 Lessons
2. Model simple objects using ball technique for fine motor development
3. Model freely for fun
4. Display finished objects for appreciating own and others work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify materials for modeling 2 Lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify materials for modeling 2 Lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Model simple objects using ball technique for fine motor development
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to model simple objects using ball technique for fine motor development. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Model freely for fun
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to model freely for fun. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. Display finished objects for appreciating own and others work
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display finished objects for appreciating own and others work. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Modeling using ball technique.
2. Explain Modeling using ball technique to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: Identify materials for modeling 2 Lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Modeling using ball technique. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Modeling using ball technique important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
